bundles.name: Parabola Lab
bundles.description: An interactive parabola explorer with Learn, Explore, and Practice modes. Features a glassmorphism UI with a Dublin, CA landscape background, real-time graph manipulation with sliders, AI tutor chat, and challenge mode to test your skills.
bundles.author: shawkatkabbara

bundles.name: Google Connector
bundles.description: Connect your Google account to Paprwork with one click. Setup wizard, automatic OAuth callback, and scheduled token refresh.
bundles.author: naughty-rooster

bundles.name: X Action Engine
bundles.description: AI-powered X/Twitter engagement engine. Fetches your timeline, scores tweets with Papr Memory context, generates draft replies and quote tweets in your voice, and learns from your edits over time.
bundles.author: amirkabbara

bundles.name: Investor Data Room
bundles.description: Full-featured investor data room template with 1,062 real VCs, portfolio intelligence, competitive analysis (2x2 + market map), moat & defensibility, GTM strategy, financial model, and one-click Vercel deployment. Pre-loaded with Sleep AI template data — type your company name and Pen builds your room in under a minute.
bundles.author: shawkatkabbara
